title: Oscar and the Ember
author: Ivo Nakamura
blurb: Silas Nakamura, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
